description: This Dart source file implements a DatabaseService class that manages SQLite database operations for a notes application, including initializing the database, creating tables, inserting, updating, deleting, fetching notes, and seeding sample data.

classes.name: DatabaseService
classes.description: A singleton class providing access to an SQLite database for managing notes, including creation, insertion, update, deletion, retrieval, and seeding sample notes.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Getter that initializes and returns the database instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: _initDB
methods.description: Initializes the database with the specified filename, creating the schema if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database and returns the note with the assigned ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from the database by its ID.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches all notes, optionally filtered by category, sorted by pinned status and update time.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: seedSampleNotesIfEmpty
methods.description: Seeds the database with predefined sample notes if the table is empty.
